public_requirement: All five declared output files (processed_spectra.json, cosine_greedy_scores.npz, modified_cosine_scores.npz, spectrum_metadata.csv, best_matches_spectrum97.csv) must exist as non-empty files at the declared paths directly under the supplied output root, with no extra directory layer.

The processed spectral library must match the reference exactly in structure and scientific content: array of N spectra in spectrum-index order, each a JSON object with exactly the reference's set of metadata fields (no extra or missing fields), string identifiers compared exactly, numeric metadata equal within 1e-9 absolute, and the processed peak lists ([m/z, normalized intensity] pairs, JSON numbers) equal in count and value within 1e-9 absolute after canonical m/z-then-intensity ordering; missing, non-numeric, nonfinite or string-encoded peak values fail.

The .npz archive must contain exactly the arrays CosineGreedy_score (2-D floating-point) and CosineGreedy_matches (2-D integer), both N x N in spectrum-index layout, symmetric in (i,j), with finite, non-negative values. Scores must agree with the reference within 1e-8 absolute and matched-peak counts exactly.

The .npz archive must contain exactly the arrays ModifiedCosine_score (2-D floating-point) and ModifiedCosine_matches (2-D integer), both N x N in spectrum-index layout, symmetric in (i,j), with finite, non-negative values. Scores must agree with the reference within 1e-8 absolute and matched-peak counts exactly.

The table must have the exact header spectrum_index,compound_name,precursor_mz,inchikey,smiles and one row per spectrum numbered 0..N-1 in spectrum-index order (no duplicates, no gaps). compound_name, inchikey and smiles are compared as exact strings (missing metadata as empty fields); precursor_mz must parse as a finite number equal to the reference within 1e-9 absolute.

The table must have the exact header rank,smiles,inchikey,ModifiedCosine_score,ModifiedCosine_matches and at most 10 rows with rank running 0.. in order, scores non-increasing downward, each ModifiedCosine_matches an integer >= 5, smiles/inchikey exactly matching the reference rows, ModifiedCosine_score within 1e-8 absolute and ModifiedCosine_matches exactly equal to the reference. Each row must additionally be consistent with the submitter's own outputs: its score and match count must occur at some candidate index in row 97 of the submitted modified-cosine matrices for a spectrum whose submitted metadata table carries that row's smiles/inchikey.
